_comment: AI model artifacts the visitor's browser downloads at run time (they are not in the site bundle). Which models exist is read from the shipped code by `gen:sbom-versions:check` (public/data/embeddings-meta.json); licenses and revisions below were read from the model repositories on `fetchedAt` because no shipped file carries them. The site pins no revision for any of them, so each follows its repository's default branch and this record is a dated snapshot, not a guarantee.

models.role: text embeddings for search (quantized ONNX, q8)
models.licenseSource: the Xenova repository declares mit; base model BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5 (revision a5beb1e3e68b9ab74eb54cfd186867f64f240e1a) declares mit
